products.name: Insulated Steel Bottle
products.shortDescription: Double-wall vacuum bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours and hot for 12.
products.description: A 500 ml double-wall stainless steel bottle with a leak-proof lid and powder-coated matte finish. Its smooth surface takes laser engraving and logo printing beautifully, making it a daily reminder of your brand.

products.name: Artisan Ceramic Mug Set
products.shortDescription: Set of two hand-glazed ceramic mugs presented in a kraft gift box.
products.description: Two 300 ml stoneware mugs with a reactive green glaze, each one subtly unique. Packed in a recycled kraft box with a personalised message card.

products.name: Copper Bottle Gift Set
products.shortDescription: Pure copper bottle with two matching tumblers in a premium presentation box.
products.description: A 900 ml hammered copper bottle with two 200 ml tumblers, finished with a lacquer coating. A traditional wellness gift that feels premium and festive.

products.name: Organic Cotton Polo
products.shortDescription: Soft 220 GSM organic cotton polo with a tailored fit and reinforced collar.
products.description: A breathable organic cotton piqué polo available in sizes XS to 3XL and a range of earthy shades. Ideal as team uniform or onboarding apparel.

products.name: Premium Fleece Zip Jacket
products.shortDescription: Warm, lightweight recycled-fleece jacket with zipped pockets and a clean finish.
products.description: Made from recycled polyester fleece with a brushed interior, a full-length zip and two zipped pockets. A premium gift for the colder months.

products.name: Embroidered Cotton Cap
products.shortDescription: Six-panel brushed cotton cap with an adjustable strap and embroidered logo.
products.description: A lightweight six-panel cap with a curved brim and metal strap clasp. A budget-friendly branded giveaway for events and field teams.

products.name: Leather Executive Notebook
products.shortDescription: A5 vegan-leather notebook with 160 pages of thick, ink-friendly paper.
products.description: A5 hardbound notebook with a vegan leather cover, ribbon marker, elastic closure and pen loop. Lays flat for comfortable writing.

products.name: Metal Pen & Cardholder Set
products.shortDescription: Brushed-metal roller pen with a slim business card holder in a gift case.
products.description: A weighted brushed-metal pen and matching card holder, presented in a magnetic-close gift case. A refined desk essential for leadership gifting.

products.name: Wireless Charging Desk Pad
products.shortDescription: Vegan-leather desk mat with a built-in 15W wireless charger.
products.description: An oversized desk mat with a built-in Qi 15W wireless charging zone and a water-resistant, easy-clean surface. Combines utility with a polished desk presence.

products.name: Anti-Theft Laptop Backpack
products.shortDescription: Water-resistant 25 L backpack with a hidden zip, USB port and padded laptop sleeve.
products.description: A 25 L commuter backpack that fits laptops up to 16 inches, with a concealed back pocket, external USB charging port and ergonomic padded straps.

products.name: Aroma Diffuser & Candle Hamper
products.shortDescription: Reed diffuser and soy candle duo in calming sandalwood, packed in a wooden tray.
products.description: A hand-poured soy candle and a reed diffuser in a soothing sandalwood and tea-leaf blend, arranged in a natural wooden tray with shredded paper filler.

products.name: Herbal Tea & Honey Hamper
products.shortDescription: Assorted herbal teas, raw forest honey and a bamboo stirrer in a reusable box.
products.description: Three loose-leaf herbal blends, a jar of raw forest honey and a bamboo honey dipper in a reusable keepsake box with a ribbon finish.

products.name: Yoga Mat & Strap Set
products.shortDescription: 6 mm eco-friendly TPE yoga mat with a carry strap and cotton storage bag.
products.description: A non-slip, 6 mm TPE yoga mat with alignment lines, a cotton carry strap and a drawstring storage bag. Supports your wellness-at-work programmes.

products.name: Signature Wellness Hamper
products.shortDescription: Our flagship hamper with bath salts, candle, tea, dry fruits and a bamboo journal.
products.description: A curated hamper in a handwoven basket: Himalayan bath salts, a soy candle, premium tea, roasted nuts and a bamboo-cover journal, finished with a personalised note.
